name: open_app
description: Open an app from the installed-app list by name or alias.

name: search_app
description: Search YouTube, Netflix, Spotify, Prime Video, Stremio or Play Store. Verify results with read_screen. Spotify instead plays the best match: call once, then verify with tv_status. For other apps use open_app, remote, read_screen and type_text.

query.description: Title, artist, topic or phrase to search for.

name: open_url
description: Open an https link in its handling app.

name: remote
description: Navigate menus with remote buttons; use times to scroll repeatedly. Sleep/wake the TV; "turn it off" or "go to sleep" means sleep.

name: media
description: Control whatever is playing: play, pause, toggle, next/previous track or episode, stop, rewind or fast-forward.

name: volume
description: Change TV volume. up/down move by steps; set takes a percentage 0–100; mute/unmute remember the old level.

amount.description: Percent for set (0–100); steps for up/down (1–8, default 2). Null otherwise.

name: read_screen
description: Take a screenshot of the TV. Use it to verify results, find items to select, or read what an app shows.

name: tap
description: Tap a point using pixel coordinates from the latest read_screen.

name: type_text
description: Type into the focused text field, optionally pressing Enter afterwards.

name: wait
description: Briefly yield only when the latest screen shows loading, then check again. Never wait after the requested result is verified. Each call waits at most one second.

seconds.description: Use 1. Older values up to 8 are shortened to 1 second.

name: tv_status
description: Refresh foreground app, playback title/state and volume. Prefer this over screenshots for what is playing; refresh stale or missing context and check playback after changes.

name: timer
description: Set, list or cancel timers and reminders. When a timer fires, DuoBuddy speaks the label.

name: memory
description: Remember, list or forget short notes. Only when the user explicitly asks you to remember or forget something. Notes go to the person at the TV when one has said who they are, otherwise to the household.

note.description: Note to save, or text matching notes to forget.

scope.description: household for things about everyone ("we", "the kids"), person for the speaker's own preferences. Null to decide automatically.

name: profile
description: Who is at the TV. switch and greet by name when someone identifies themselves ("it's Mum", "this is Onur"); leave when they say they are going or hand over; list to name everyone DuoBuddy knows; birthday to save someone's birthday.

name.description: First name or family title, e.g. Mum.

name: screensaver
description: Show the clock/weather dashboard for "screensaver", "ambient mode" or "just show the clock". Any remote button closes it.
